title: Prism AWS Architecture kit: diagram family
description: A family file (catalog/aws-kit/json/<family>.json): one gallery section of diagrams compiled by catalog/aws-kit/awd.mjs. Describes every field the generator reads; checkSpec() in awd.mjs adds what a schema cannot say (references resolve, ids are unique, icon ids exist, 0 < a < b < 1, extra is safe). See catalog/drafts/AWS_KIT.md. Uses only the JSON Schema subset that catalog/aws-kit/spec.mjs validates.

window.description: [a, b]: a window on the diagram clock as fractions of dur, 0 < a < b < 1.

title.description: Section heading. A spaced dash or an em/en dash starts a subtitle the catalog drops from the category.

id.description: Unique across the whole gallery; prefixed with the family code (sl-, tt-, ds-, db-, mr-, vp-, tg-, ep-, dns-). The catalog id is aws-<id>.

name.description: Tile title; also the svg <title> and the default aria-label.

desc.description: One or two plain sentences: the architecture and what animates. Also the svg <desc>.

full.description: Tile spans the whole row (viewBox up to 1400 x 900).

lintAllow.description: Accepted lint findings: '<code>' or '<code>:<start of message>'.

dur.description: Seconds: the single clock every animation in the diagram shares (default 6).

poster.description: The moment of the clock (a fraction in [0, 1)) a still export shows: frame(spec, 'poster'). Omitted: the plain still diagram.

groups.description: Frames, drawn in order: outer groups first.

flows.description: Paths through the diagram that compile to timeline entries, rings and numbered steps (after the spec's own).

marks.description: Blocked X or ok check on a node, a wire or a point.

extra.description: Raw SVG appended last. No script, on* handlers, foreignObject/style/iframe/object/embed, javascript: URLs, or href/url() that is not a #fragment.

id.description: Needed when another flow runs with this one.

path.description: Node ids in travel order; each pair names the wire between them (either direction).

wires.description: Wire ids in travel order, for wires drawn with d (no from/to), or hops with options.

reply.description: The response comes back along the same wires (pk-2).

steps.description: false: no numbered badges for this flow.

with.description: Run at the same time as this flow.

t.description: Pin the flow's window; default: flows share the clock in order.

pace.description: length (default): one speed, a long wire takes longer; even: equal windows.

ring.description: Ring node on arrival (default: the wire's far end); false for none.

tone.description: Category color for the frame (a custom group).

fill.description: A light tint of the tone (or gray) inside the frame.

dashed.description: Override the kind's solid or dashed line.

id.description: Needed when an effect targets the group (fail).

label.description: Header text (default: the kind's official name; empty for gen).

icon.description: Corner icon: an icon id, or false for none (default: the kind's group icon).

note.description: Right-aligned on the top edge: a CIDR, a route summary, an account id.

align.description: Header alignment (default: centered for frames without an icon).

icon.description: Icon id from catalog/aws-icons/aws-icons.json (aws-svc-*, aws-res-*). A base id with -dark/-light colorways swaps with the theme; [dark, light] names the pair explicitly.

label.description: Official name, centered under the icon.

sub.description: Muted second line under the label.

labelPos.description: Label below (default), right, left or above the icon.

kind.description: A plain shape instead of an icon, for what has no AWS icon; needs w and h, label inside.

tone.description: Box stroke in a category color.

from.description: Source node id (auto-routed when d is absent).

d.description: Explicit path: M, H, V, L and numbers only.

via.description: Pins the elbow of an auto-routed wire (x for a horizontal route, y for a vertical one).

both.description: Bidirectional: a head at both ends.

hot.description: Red wire and head: a blocked or failing path.

labelBg.description: A halo in the tile color behind the label.

labelDy.description: Vertical nudge of the label (default -5, above).

at.description: Wire id the badge sits on.

x.description: Free position, when not on a wire.

text.description: What happens at this step: one or two sentences for the numbered list under the diagram and its desc. One text per number (the first badge of a repeated number).

wire.description: Moves a packet along this wire during t.

kind.description: pk request (default), pk-2 response or replication, pk-bad failed traffic.

ring.description: Node (id) or point { x, y, r } that pulses a ring at the end of t (red for pk-bad).

appear.description: Node shown only during t (scale-out / scale-in).

fail.description: Group id that turns red with an X during t.

ghost.description: appear only: a 30% copy marks the slot outside t.

kind.description: caption muted (default), label ink, warn red.

t.description: Shows the note only during this window.

off.description: Hides a standing note during this window (a timed note takes its place).

still.description: A timed note also shows in still frames.

on.description: A node (top-right of its icon) or a wire (at f).

t.description: Shows the mark only during this window.

still.description: A timed mark also shows in still frames.

legend.description: Key drawn inside the diagram from (x, y), one row per item (or one line with row); items default to the packet kinds the timeline uses.

row.description: All items on one line instead of one per row.
